verdict.rationale: Warp claims to offer an 'API, CLI, SDK and MCP' as a platform (warp-docs-42) and an OpenAPI spec is confirmed live (warp-probe-2), suggesting some programmatic surface exists, but there is no documentation, language bindings, code samples, or reference material specifically for an 'SDK' beyond this one-line marketing mention. Missing for 10: dedicated SDK docs/reference, language-specific client libraries, usage examples, and any independent/hands-on confirmation that a real SDK (not just API/CLI) exists.
